yarn.meaning: Every point survives: the digital-government opportunity, talented colleagues, the culture, partnering across government, strategic and practical, open and iterative delivery, asking for feedback, thanks. "doing work that really gets you fired up" shifts "inspiring work" from work that inspires to work that excites the newcomer.
yarn.sense: Terms mostly fit: "a ripper bunch of people", "We're dead set on working in an open, iterative and user-centred way", "please sing out if you see any way we can do better", "We’re stoked to have you on board". "We're out not only to lead the way" strains a little for "We strive".
yarn.authenticity: Natural Australian workplace warmth: "drag our government into the digital age", "they care heaps". "keeps us keen as mustard" is a stock simile.
yarn.register: Level 3: a warm Aussie retelling that keeps the letter's shape; "bloody talented" sits within vulgarity 1.
yarn.tone: Keeps the upbeat welcome-letter tone throughout.
yarn.flow: Reads smoothly; "We're out not only to lead the way in technology, but to show" is a little stiff.
yarn.variety: Varied: "ripper", "fired up", "keen as mustard", "heaps", "top partner", "dead set on", "sing out", "stoked", "on board".

engine.meaning: Every point survives because the text is the original almost word for word.
engine.sense: Wrong-sense swaps: "a remarkable group of punters" (punters are customers, gamblers or the general public, not colleagues); "our bloody organisation" reads as exasperation, not emphasis.
engine.authenticity: Mechanical swaps in untouched US corporate prose: "a remarkable group of punters doing inspiring work", "a bloody great partner", "We aim to make our bloody organisation as agile".
engine.register: Far under level 3: the original verbatim apart from "punters", "dead set on", two "bloody" and "organisation".
engine.tone: Mostly the original tone, but "our bloody organisation" introduces an exasperated note into a welcome letter.
engine.flow: Reads like the original; the inserted "bloody" jars: "make our bloody organisation as agile and user-centric".
engine.variety: Little Aussie; "bloody" used twice of four swaps.

unharnessed.meaning: Every point survives. "we try to show off the modern, collaborative, diverse culture" shifts "exemplify" (model) toward flaunting.
unharnessed.sense: Terms fit: "a ripper bunch of people", "keeps us fired up", "top-notch partner", "give us a yell", "stoked to have you". "show off" strains slightly for "exemplify".
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural Australian welcome: "drag our government into the digital age", "doing seriously inspiring work", "So give us a yell if you see any way we can do better."
unharnessed.register: Level 3: warm and Aussie without going over; "bloody talented" within vulgarity 1.
unharnessed.tone: Keeps the upbeat welcome tone throughout.
unharnessed.flow: Reads smoothly: "Being able to work well with colleagues across government is crucial to us making a difference."
